mechanism_narrative: A sustained 4-quarter decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.5% signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically leads to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in weak demand periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 2% signals accelerating supply-side activity, which historically leads to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals monetary tightening, which historically leads to higher discount rates applied to equity cash flows and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
